input_images.role: edit target; retain palette, tactile 3D editorial materials, transparent circuit cards, abstract substrate

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept editorial illustration.
Asset type: 16:9 hero for a Korean technical review on generative AI agents for quantum circuit synthesis.
Input image 1 is the existing hero edit target. Preserve its warm off-white studio background, muted teal/charcoal/pale gray materials, tiny vermilion accents, tactile scientific 3D editorial finish, transparent circuit cards and generic abstract hardware style. Substantially redesign the composition so the ACTION OF AN AI AGENT is unmistakable in one second, not merely a circuit shrinking through filters.

MAIN COMPOSITION:
The dominant largest subject, central-left and inside the central 85% safe area, is a non-humanoid teal software agent control console / workspace. A broad upright face reads EXACTLY "AI AGENT" in large, crisp charcoal sans-serif uppercase, with a modest <> code symbol. AI AGENT must be comfortably legible in a 366 px-wide thumbnail. This is a software orchestration workspace, no robot/person/brain.
A small off-white specification card with a few clean abstract constraint lines feeds from upper-left into the agent through one teal directional arrow.
The agent sends a clear teal arrow toward three small transparent candidate circuit cards above and to its right, labelled EXACTLY "PROPOSE" in medium-large simple type above the arrow. One candidate visibly has a single vermilion-highlighted gate and a small understated crossed-out mark indicating a rejected candidate, not all candidates passing.
The candidates lead to a distinct small pale-gray tool module on the right labelled EXACTLY "CHECK" in large readable type. This checker must be spatially separate from the AI AGENT and plainly be an independent tool. A small unlabelled synthesis-tool console may sit between the candidates and checker, but avoid clutter.
The key causal story is an unmistakable broad curved vermilion RETURN ARROW from CHECK back to the AI AGENT. The arrowhead terminates at the agent workspace, not at the output. Label this return and correction loop EXACTLY "REFINE" in crisp large type. At the agent edge, show a small second circuit revision card with that single gate relocated or replaced, making iteration visible.
After the independent checker, only one small selected transparent circuit card exits to the far right on a modest generic abstract matte substrate. This final result should be visually secondary, not dominate, and not imply actual QPU performance has been measured.

LAYOUT/READABILITY:
Flat-ish isometric 3D composition with raised tactile objects, not an intricate architectural schematic. Clear left-to-right causal direction and one unambiguous curved return loop. Keep the entire agent-candidates-checker-refine story within central 85% width and central 80% height. Agent and feedback loop are largest visual focus; final hardware is small. Plenty of calm negative space. Large simple legible text with high contrast. Use only these four word labels, exactly: "AI AGENT", "PROPOSE", "CHECK", "REFINE". No other text, no numeric claims.
Light soft daylight, premium scientific magazine cover illustration, clean physical materials, restrained saturation. Preserve original visual elegance, introduce purposeful teal outgoing arrows and a vermilion feedback arrow.
Avoid: robot heads, human figures, brains, magical glow, real QPU device, corporate logos, quantum advantage or performance badges, numbers, fake code walls, many crossing arrows, tangled webs, tiny illegible labels. No quantitative chart. Opaque warm off-white background, no transparency.

export.resampling: Pillow LANCZOS, ImageOps.fit center crop; ~0.06% vertical crop to 16:9

conceptual_status: Conceptual editorial illustration; no experimental measurements or actual QPU performance are represented.

criteria: AI AGENT is the largest foreground subject.
Three candidate circuits, one visibly rejected, are reached by PROPOSE arrow.
Independent CHECK module is spatially separate from agent.
Broad vermilion REFINE arrow visibly returns from checker to AI AGENT.
Final circuit and generic substrate are visually secondary.
Only intended word labels AI AGENT, PROPOSE, CHECK, REFINE are present.
No robot, brain, logo, numeric benchmark, or real QPU device.
limitations: Gate symbols and circuit revisions are conceptual, not executable circuits.
Checker icon represents tool invocation, not a claim of formal proof or measured hardware performance.

mobile_preview_inspected.result: AI AGENT and REFINE labels remain legible; proposal-to-check-to-refine causal loop is visible.
